profile.headline: Software Engineer | C# | .NET | SQL Server | API Development
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining applications in C#, .NET, and SQL Server. Skilled in API development, integration, and optimization with hands-on expertise in OData, Swagger, and Postman testing. Adept at working across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), applying Agile/Scrum practices, and collaborating with cross-functional and international teams. Proven ability to deliver scalable solutions, improve system performance, and produce clear technical documentation for developers, stakeholders, and end users.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Maintained and updated a legacy .NET codebase, including API endpoints with custom OData payloads, Swagger documentation, and Postman testing. Managed and optimized SQL stored procedures and queries to troubleshoot proprietary software. Utilized Azure DevOps, JIRA, and Git for source control, code reviews, and project tracking. Resolved customer support tickets via HubSpot, Salesforce, and direct communication. Authored technical documentation and API version comparisons for developers, support staff, and end users using Confluence, OneNote, and SharePoint. Led and participated in daily Scrum meetings and cross-departmental planning sessions. Coordinated with overseas development teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework · HubSpot · Customer Service · Full-Stack Development · JSON · SQL · WinForms · Agile Methodologies · Jenkins · .NET Framework · GitHub · REST APIs · Sonarqube · Scrum · Documentation · Microsoft SQL Server · Git · HTML · Jira · JavaScript · Version Control · Azure DevOps Services · Postman API

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description: Led development of RESTful API projects using C# .NET Framework, NHibernate, and MSSQL to enhance the company’s SaaS product. Created and maintained unit tests for data importers, API endpoints, and client DLLs to diagnose and resolve API issues. Collaborated with project managers, clients, and developers to plan and execute development, testing, and deployment strategies. Produced technical documentation to support developer and end-user adoption. Mentored new team members through one-on-one onboarding sessions.

organizations.description: Under RIT's Center for Leadership and Civic Engagement, momentum is a program dedicated to developing students' leadership skills while providing application opportunities in real-world volunteer settings. momentum encourages participants to determine their individual strengths and use them towards team-based brainstorming, problem solving, and event leading.
